### 1. LAYOUT & REGIONS
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows 11 chrome).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0) – (1024, 45):** App icon + Title (Left), Action cluster (Right: Buy Now, Settings, Info, Menu, Min/Max/Close).
*   **Navigation Toolbar (0, 46) – (1024, 115):** 
    *   Left: Home, Back, Forward, Up buttons; Current Path display.
    *   Right: View toggle, Filter button, Search box.
*   **Main Content Area (0, 116) – (1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left):** (0, 116) – (275, 855). Contains "Path/Type" tabs and a hierarchical file tree.
    *   **File List (Center):** (276, 116) – (795, 855). Contains column headers and a scrollable list of files/folders.
    *   **Preview Pane (Right):** (796, 116) – (1024, 855). Displays details for the selected item.
*   **Status Bar / Footer (0, 856) – (1024, 768):** 
    *   Left: Status message with icon.
    *   Right: Primary CTA ("Recover All...").
*   **Windows Taskbar:** Visible at the very bottom.

### 3. COLOR (ESTIMATED HEX)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App Background: `#F5F7FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Tree/List Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Selected Row Background: `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
    *   Preview Pane Background: `#F9FAFB` (Off-white/Grey)
    *   Header/Footer Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#333333` (Dark Grey)
    *   Secondary/Meta Text: `#666666` or `#888888` (Grey)
    *   Link/Accent Text: `#1677FF` (Blue)
    *   Selected Text: `#000000` or Dark Blue
*   **Accents & Controls:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover All): `#1677FF` (Blue)
    *   Primary Button Text: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Secondary Button (Open): `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue bg) / `#1677FF` (Blue text)
    *   "Buy Now" Badge: `#FFA940` (Orange/Yellow)
    *   Success Icon (Checkmark): `#1677FF` (Blue circle/bg)
*   **Borders:**
    *   Dividers/Panes: `#E8E8E8` (Light Grey)
    *   Input Fields: `#D9D9D9`

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI (or System), ~9pt, Regular.
*   **Path/Breadcrumb:** Segoe UI, ~12pt, Regular.
*   **Tab Headers ("Path", "Type"):** Segoe UI, ~13pt, Medium (Selected is Blue/Darker).
*   **List Headers ("Name", etc.):** Segoe UI, ~12pt, Regular.
*   **List Items (File Names):** Segoe UI, ~12-13pt, Regular.
*   **Meta Data (Dates/Sizes):** Segoe UI, ~11pt, Regular, Grey.
*   **Status Bar Text:** Segoe UI, ~13pt, Semi-bold (for numbers), Regular (for label).
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~12pt, Medium.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px - 44px.
*   **Icon Size (Folder/File):** 24x24px or 32x32px.
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Search Box: ~32px.
    *   Buttons (Filter, Open, Recover): ~32px - 36px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~12px (after checkbox/icon).
    *   Pane Gaps: ~1px (border) to 0px (flush).
    *   Content Margins: ~16px - 20px.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Search Box: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Tabs (left edge): ~4px - 6px.
*   **Stroke Widths:**
    *   Borders: 1px.
    *   Icons: 1.5px - 2px (outline), or Filled.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Navigation Buttons:** Home, Back (Disabled/Greyed out), Forward (Disabled), Up.
*   **Tabs:** "Path" (Active/Selected), "Type" (Inactive). Indicator: Blue text vs Grey text, subtle background difference.
*   **Tree View Items:**
    *   Expand/Collapse arrows (Triangle icons).
    *   Checkboxes (Square, unchecked).
    *   Selection State: "Windows (C:)" has a light blue highlight background.
*   **File List:**
    *   **Checkboxes:** Square, unchecked.
    *   **Sort Indicator:** Up arrow visible on "Name" column header.
    *   **Selection State:** Row "ghcup" is selected (Light blue background `#E6F0FF`). The checkbox for this row appears focused or active (darker border/blue tint).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "Filter": Normal state (Icon + Text).
    *   "Open" (Preview pane): Secondary button style (Ghost/Light fill).
    *   "Recover All ...": Primary CTA (Solid Blue Fill).
    *   "Buy Now": Badge/Button hybrid (Yellow background).
*   **Input:** Search box (Placeholder text visible).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Modern Windows (Outline + Filled mix).
*   **Nav Icons:** Outline stroke (Home, Arrows).
*   **File Icons:** Filled style (Blue Folder icon).
*   **Action Icons:**
    *   Filter: Funnel shape.
    *   Search: Magnifying glass.
    *   View: List/Grid toggle lines.
    *   Checkmark (Footer): White tick in blue circle.
*   **Mascot:** A circular badge/bot icon in the bottom right of the preview pane (purple/blue gradient).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. A scan has finished ("Scan Completed"), and results are displayed.
*   **Context:** The user is browsing the "Windows (C:)" partition. The folder "ghcup" is currently selected/highlighted in the list, triggering the Preview Pane update.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). Scrollbar in the list view indicates more content below.
